items.title: James Moody — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Eppy was a nice guy, though.

ctx.x: You mean all the guys in the band had guns?

Yeah! [laughter] Yeah, man! And then one time we were on the bus and Eppy [phonetic sp.], the bus driver, said something to Lorraine [phonetic sp.], and we were down South, and Dizzy grabbed him up the collar and said, "You don't talk to my wife!" And people said, "Dizzy, please, wait till we get to Washington!" [laughter] You know. He was about to get us all killed out there. [laughs] Yep! It's funny. [indiscernible] Yeah, go ahead.
The traveling conditions at that time for musicians who were playing like you were going on that circuit and everything, that must've been very -­
